collection.title: Ferrari Mondial 1980 to 1988 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ferrari Mondial 1980 - 1988 model requires a 20" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
